business.body:
- 31+ year track record as an RBI-licensed Authorized Dealer Category II, headquartered in Chennai (BSE: PRITHVIEXCH).
- Serves a diversified customer base spanning corporate travelers (IT/manufacturing/services), shipping crew wages (cash to master), celebrities, government companies, students studying abroad, UHNIs and frequent leisure travelers.
- Recognised with multiple industry awards, including Deloitte India's Enterprise Growth Award, Tamil Nadu Tourism's 'Best Forex Service' award (2016, 2017), and ASSOCHAM's Tourism & Hospitality Award (2018), plus VISA membership.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body: - [Macro Risk] Persistent geopolitical tensions, including the prolonged Israel-Iran conflict and consequent oil-price-driven rise in flight fares, are dampening outbound travel demand to the Gulf and beyond; consumers are shifting toward essential over discretionary travel, with shorter trips and lower average spend per trip.
